method: Visible native GUI: keep workspace 1 response BROWSER_A blocked, navigate back, uncheck all groups, navigate back again and select workspace 2, release the original request. Only the task-owned synthetic Testcenter was used.
observed: The native GUI allows both group and workspace changes while its old request is pending.
The old worker then continues its remaining report requests against workspace 2 although it started in workspace 1.
The old target XLSX is still written in the background and contains the one workspace-1 BROWSER_A person; all cells are reconstructed.
browserBehaviour: Existing request guard freezes workspace/group inputs and module/tool navigation. A cancellation restores controls; a subsequent request can use a new selection. This deliberately prevents the native source-mixing behaviour.
comparison: All cells of the original background workbook; ordered metadata-only endpoint log, retained pending-request path, and visible selections. No authentication headers, credentials or response bodies logged.
limits: Native unsafe source mixing is documented, not reproduced as successful browser equivalence.
